title: GitWeave Policy
description: Schema for gitweave self-serve policy configuration (config/policy.yaml)

allowed_request_types.description: Self-serve request types this team may submit

allowed_repo_patterns.description: Glob patterns for repo names this team may act on

allowed_content_settings.description: Content setting keys this team may modify

allowed_modules.description: GitWeave module names this team is permitted to apply
